pr_title: store/tikv,util/logutil: add a function to convert proto.Message to hex format
pr_body:
<!--
Thank you for contributing to TiDB! Please read TiDB's [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) document **BEFORE** filing this PR.
-->

### What problem does this PR solve? <!--add issue link with summary if exists-->

Fix https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/11506

### What is changed and how it works?

We've come to an agreement to use the hex format for key encoding in the log (tidb, tikv and pd), but the `proto.Message` doesn't support it directly.
In this commit, I come up with a customed `ToHex` function to encode a `proto.Message` object into a string.

I'm not sure is it necessary to expose a more general function that works on `interface{}`.

The encoded `metapb.Region` looks like this:

```
{Id:6662 StartKey:74c85c0000005c000000252d0000000000000025 EndKey:3361736733617364 RegionEpoch:<nil> Peers:[]}
```

issue_context.title: May use hex format to print the keys
issue_context.body:
## General Question

```
[2019/07/29 17:01:13.247 +08:00] [INFO] [split_region.go:67] ["split region complete"] [at=dIAAAAAAAAAt] ["new region left"="id:42 start_key:\"t\\200\\000\\000\\000\\000\\000\\000\\377-\\000\\000\\000\\000\\000\\000\\000\\370\" region_epoch:<version:1 > peers:<id:43 store_id:1 > "] ["new region right"=<nil>]
```
I find that the output key is still protobuf readable format, but I remember we have decided to use hex for printing keys.

review_comments:
@tiancaiamao  how about let `logutil.ToHex` and `hex.EncodeToString` return a Stringer?

zap's Stringer is powerful, `zap.String` will be eval even if Info level is disabled, but `Stringer` will not do that.
how about return w, then we could still use `zap.Stringer` in somewhere.

`zap.Stringer` can be used on something that implements the [`fmt.Stringer`](https://godoc.org/fmt#Stringer) interface.

We can't implement `String() string` for `metapb.Region` because it's defined in the `kvproto` package, we can't modify that package.
